global: This miso ramen boasts a rich, amber broth, topped with tender chashu pork, crisp nori, and vibrant green onions. Served in a blue-and-white patterned bowl, it rests on a wooden table under soft, natural light.

regions.background: Light brown wooden table with visible grain patterns and natural texture, showing subtle surface variations.
regions.bowl: Blue and white ceramic bowl with geometric patterned rim, glossy finish, and visible "NEN" text on its edge.
regions.soup: Miso ramen broth with noodles, green onions, and toppings, appearing creamy, golden-brown, and richly textured.
regions.spoon: White plastic spoon with smooth, slightly glossy surface, curved bowl shape, and faint embossed text on its underside.
regions.seaweed: Nori seaweed pieces show dark green, textured, irregular shapes with visible salt crystals and slight curling edges.
regions.meat: Chashu pork: golden-brown, crispy-edged, tender-looking slice with visible fat marbling and slight char.
